query:
SELECT s.name, s.weight, s.category, i.value, p.year, p.month, p.label 
FROM ims_data i 
JOIN ssof_skus s ON s.id = i.sku_id 
JOIN ssof_periods p ON p.id = i.period_id 
WHERE p.year = 2026 AND p.month = 4 AND s.country IN ('Syria', 'Libya')
ORDER BY s.category, s.weight, s.name
